与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:凯特的经历、感受与成长。
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Little by little, things began to change. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Best of all, apple blossom covers the trees in spring.

The green hill looked quieter than usual that evening. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Kate believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. A solitary knoll breaks the flatland.

Jack always says that small steps matter more than big plans. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Jack and Kate are preparing a report about the green hill. What's more, chuck organized the neighborhood barbecue again this summer.
Kate will take part in a football match in November. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Kate is saving money to buy a ticket to Paris. Also, polar bears hunt on sea ice.
On Thursday evenings, Kate reviews the notes from class. At first, Kate found it difficult to keep the habit. The experience taught Kate more than any book could.
